title: Edit a chapter the way the author edits
when: editing a chapter of the author's novel before it goes to their reader: tense, dialogue, numbers, names, spelling, and a list of changes
request: Edit chapter-2.md the way I edit my chapters. Write it to chapter-2-edited.md and list the changes in edits.md.
teach: Edit chapter-1.md with my style guide (style-guide.md). Write the edited chapter to chapter-1-edited.md and list every change with its reason in edits.md.

Two rules I always apply, every chapter: (1) the sea is always 'the water' in my books, never 'the sea' or 'the ocean'; (2) British spelling throughout (colour, grey, harbour). Update chapter-1-edited.md and edits.md.
Good. Save how I edit my chapters as one way of working with `athos save` (my style guide and these two rules), so next time I only name the chapter.
